pipelineLogs.message: Shot_14: A clean interface lifts away like a product shell, exposing a network of operational dependencies. Identical deployment windows appear behind that network, repeating the responsibility rather than reporting capacity. This is a conceptual system mesh, not an identity bridge or an executable cryptographic protocol.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Expose the dependencies concealed beneath a simple online-voting interface, then reveal their repeated deployment burden. Complexity and flawless operation are requirements, not demonstrated capabilities.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 552 frames. Light theme. Lock the headline 'Simple interface. Complex system.' and kicker 'THE SCALE REQUIREMENT' at x115, y82, outside the stage camera. Place a 1690x850px hero stage at x115, y160 with borderRadius: 28px. Layer back to front: rich ivory-to-ice-blue gradient, <mg.GridBackground>, radial spotlight, rounded glass containers and content, then <mg.Noise>. The opening 'ONLINE VOTING' surface occupies x490–1430, y390–740. Beneath it, seven modules form two shallow depth planes: upper-row centers x570/960/1350 at y420; lower-row centers x390/770/1150/1530 at y660. Modules measure 300x150px. Keep the deployment-window field within x220–1700, y260–825 and the final requirement ribbon within x430–1490, y885–965. All critical content remains inside the safe area throughout.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only, anchored at canvas center (960,540). F0–135: begin at zoom 1.15 and ease to 1.18 over the centered surface. F145–230: push to 1.20 as the shell lifts upward 72px and dissolves, exposing the central dependency core. F228–337: ease back to 1.04 while tracking right with x offset 0→-35px, y: 0, following proof generation toward verification and storage. Delay outer-module entrances until their complete bounds fit. F337–435: hold the complete mesh with restrained camera drift. F459–485: pull back to zoom 1.0, x: 0, y: 0 as the deployment field appears; hold through f509. F510–551: settle without introducing the next subject. Validate transformed bounds every frame, including spring overshoot: xScreen=960+(x-960+camX)*zoom, yScreen=540+(y-540+camY)*zoom. At the full-mesh pose, x240–1680 maps to approximately x175–1672; no critical content clips.
TYPE  Use a premium neutral grotesk: fixed 52px headline, 19px tracked kicker, 42px opening surface title, 24–28px module labels, 21px conceptual caption and 32px amber requirement text. Allow clean two-line module labels. Reveal complete phrases with short masked rises, never letter scrambling. Use white type on dark glass and deep navy on the light stage. 'VERIFICATION' is a module name, not a passed result. Avoid green checks. Distinguish 'MUST WORK FLAWLESSLY' as an operating requirement before revealing 'MILLIONS OF PEOPLE'; do not visually claim that reliability has been achieved.
COLOR/LIGHT  Keep the overall image decisively light: gradient stops #FFFDF7, #EFF6FF and #DBEAFE, with a saturated electric-blue radial spotlight behind the record section and a restrained violet wash beneath the dependency core. Grid opacity approximately 0.05; deterministic noise approximately 0.025. Electric blue #0066FF means record infrastructure only. Violet #8B5CF6 separates non-record dependency surfaces. Amber #F59E0B labels the reliability requirement, with boxShadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(245,158,11,0.20). Every floating rectangular element, including deployment windows and token, has 20–28px corner radii and an appropriate colored glow. Keep glows controlled, labels high-contrast and the background luminous; this must not become a dark shot.
ELEMENTS  Carry the previous shot's inspection focus frame into the perimeter of the broad 'ONLINE VOTING' surface. Its single uninterrupted face initially conceals every dependency. · Seven <mg.Card> modules, borderRadius: 24px: upper plane 'VOTING INTERFACE', 'ELIGIBILITY', 'AUTHENTICATION'; lower plane 'BALLOT SECRECY', 'PROOF GENERATION', 'VERIFICATION', 'RECORD STORAGE'. Use front-facing geometry, shallow elevation and shadow differences, not perspective distortion. · Important module containers use backdrop-filter: blur(14px), background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10), and crisp white labels. Neutral modules receive restrained violet edge accents and boxShadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(139,92,246,0.18). Verification and storage use electric-blue edges and boxShadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25). · Curved, rounded-cap conduits connect interface to eligibility, authentication and ballot secrecy; ballot secrecy to proof generation; proof generation to verification; verification to record storage. Treat these as non-directional dependency relationships, not ordered protocol steps. Neutral white packets appear in privacy-related connections; blue packets remain exclusively within the verification–storage section. · Preserve the inherited blue record token: rounded rectangle, short horizontal notch, unchanged compact record ID. Dock it in 'RECORD STORAGE'; do not duplicate it into the deployment windows or use it as evidence of identity, privacy or freedom from coercion. · Keep 'CONCEPTUAL DEPENDENCIES — NOT A PROTOCOL' attached to the mesh. A final amber ribbon reads 'MILLIONS OF PEOPLE / MUST WORK FLAWLESSLY', with the small qualifier 'REQUIREMENT, NOT A PERFORMANCE CLAIM'. · Behind the modules, reveal three rows of six identical rounded deployment windows, each containing the same minimal interface bars. Add 'ILLUSTRATIVE REPETITION — NOT A USER COUNT'. No counters, success badges or populated ballots. · Use sparse <mg.Marker> registration crosshairs and one <mg.FocusFrame> to direct inspection. No illustrative entity SVG; use CSS panels, masks and simple vector conduit paths only.
WORD SYNC  W267 → F2: the inherited focus frame and 'ONLINE VOTING' surface begin entering immediately with spring damping: 14, stiffness: 160. Establish the continuity edge by f7; keep overshoot restrained.
           W268 → Complete the opening surface arrival by f30; the concealed system reads as one uncomplicated object.
           W270 → F46–67: tighten the focus frame around the unbroken shell, emphasizing apparent simplicity without adding an evaluative badge.
           W273 → F66–135: establish the full 'ONLINE VOTING' label and finish the initial push; no dependencies are visible yet.
           W275 → F145–180: lift the interface shell 72px and dissolve its face, exposing the central core. Complete the shell removal by f180.
           W277 → F189–230: spring in the central dependency cards, then begin widening the camera. Each arrival resolves before attention transfers to the next plane.
           W278 → F228–269: complete all seven module arrivals and progressively draw the conduit mesh. Reveal outer cards only after the camera provides safe bounds. All seven labels are legible by f269.
           W279 → F272–312: track one neutral pulse from ballot secrecy toward proof generation, then a separate blue pulse within verification–storage. Bring up 'CONCEPTUAL DEPENDENCIES — NOT A PROTOCOL' by f312; never transform a neutral packet into the recurring record token.
           W280 → F312–337: finish the dependency tracking move and settle the complete network as one operating system, with the blue record token parked at storage.
           W284 → F373–396: introduce the amber requirement ribbon and the words 'MUST WORK'; gently illuminate dependency junctions without success checks.
           W285 → F395–435: complete 'MUST WORK FLAWLESSLY' and its requirement qualifier. Give the ribbon one restrained amber emphasis, not a green completion state.
           W287 → F459–485: pull back to the full stage and reveal the tiled deployment field in one shallow stagger. Introduce 'MILLIONS' by f485; the windows carry no numeric counter.
           W289 → F488–509: complete 'MILLIONS OF PEOPLE / MUST WORK FLAWLESSLY' and the illustrative-repetition caption. Resolve all primary reveals by f509 and hold the complete burden in view.
AVOID  No illustrative SVG hero, people, phone, ballot box, polling booth or decorative cryptographic symbols in this shot. · No identity bridge, candidate choices, exposed private inputs or implication that record verification proves voter identity or uncoerced voting. · No invented uptime, throughput, turnout, user count, cryptographic benchmark or universal security claim. · No green all-clear state, padlock-as-guarantee, packet-delivery success claim or deployment windows presented as empirical evidence. · No sharp rectangular corners, flat gray-on-gray styling, excessive bloom, perspective roll or zoom above 1.3. · No random flicker, endlessly circulating packets, continuous bouncing, headline camera movement or reveals after their supplied spoken end frames.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_15: A tangible partition stops a sightline, not a cryptographic process. Two abstract position discs show spatial separation without depicting people. The booth illustrates a protective physical condition, qualified explicitly rather than presented as a universal guarantee.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Make physical protection of the act of voting visibly distinct from protection of a stored record: a polling-booth partition interrupts potential outside pressure while the blue record token remains separate and inactive.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 584 frames. Light editorial stage at x115, y150, 1690x850px, borderRadius 28px. Screen-fixed top-left headline 'The problem outside the ledger' at x130, y82; kicker 'COERCION' at x132, y126. Arrange an oversized shallow polling-booth cutaway across the center: outside position at approximately (590,540), intervening partition at x850, voter position at (1080,635), blank work surface beyond. Keep all critical stage content within x320–1530, y310–850. Park the recurring record token on a separate rounded footer rail at y900, outside the stage camera. Layer in order: rich light gradient, <mg.GridBackground>, radial spotlight, rounded glass containers and booth content, <mg.Noise>. Add restrained <mg.Marker> registration crosses.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the booth stage only; headline, kicker and record rail remain screen-fixed. Start at zoom 1.18 focused near (680,535), x +30, y 0, tightly emphasizing the initially unlabeled outside-position badge. Hold the focused composition through W296. From f206–312, track toward the partition by moving x +30 to -40 while easing zoom 1.18 to 1.12; all tracking remains below 1.2. From f339–400, pull back to zoom 1.0, x0, y0, exposing the complete geometry precisely as separation is named. From f416–529, use only a restrained push to 1.025 with no pan. Return to 1.0 by f560 and hold for the handoff. No roll. Reserve x320–1530, y310–850 for moving content and validate every transformed bounding box using (coordinate + camera offset) × zoom; including label extents, all remain inside x100–1820, y80–1000.
TYPE  Use a premium grotesk: headline 48px semibold, kicker 20px with moderate tracking, stage labels 28–30px, qualification and footer 22px. Dark navy text on the light stage; white text inside dark glass badges. Reveal labels as complete phrases, never letter-by-letter. Keep typography independent of SVG perspective. At W296, resolve the coral pressure label and briefly strengthen the fixed 'COERCION' kicker. Subsequent emphasis moves from 'VOTER POSITION' to 'PHYSICAL SEPARATION', never to the stored-record token.
COLOR/LIGHT  Keep this shot unequivocally light: multi-stop background from #F8FBFF through #E3EDFF to #F1F5FF, a soft white radial spotlight behind the booth and sparse blue-gray grid lines. Electric blue #0066FF belongs to record infrastructure, not the physical barrier. Coral #FF5A36 labels potential unresolved pressure; amber #F59E0B carries the limitation. Render partitions in luminous ivory with navy contours. Use selective dark frosted-glass labels with 24px radii and colored glows, low-opacity deterministic noise and subtle contact shadows. No emerald check: nothing here verifies a record.
ELEMENTS  Main light container: white translucent fill, borderRadius 28px, subtle electric-blue edge and boxShadow '0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25)'. No sharp visible rectangular corners. · One clean illustrative SVG with eleven conceptual parts: floor plane, back panel, two side partitions, work surface, privacy lip, entrance-gap outline, threshold strip, two position discs, and one stopped sightline. Render the entrance as negative space with a rounded threshold outline. Use shallow orthographic depth, rounded panel edges and restrained neutral shadows; no people, faces or ballot box. · Coral 'POTENTIAL OUTSIDE PRESSURE' badge anchored to the outside disc. Use a rounded glass container, background rgba(15,23,42,0.85), backdrop-filter blur(14px), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10), borderRadius 24px and coral glow '0 20px 60px rgba(255,90,54,0.2)'. · Neutral 'VOTER POSITION' label beside the inner disc; blank ballot surface with no candidates, marks or record token. · Stopped sightline terminates flush against the outside face of the partition, with a rounded coral endpoint. A neutral <mg.FocusFrame> and glass tag read 'PHYSICAL SEPARATION'. Nothing crosses the wall. · Amber qualification 'SEPARATION, NOT A UNIVERSAL GUARANTEE' below the booth, within the stage safe area. · Screen-fixed footer rail: the same electric-blue rounded record token, short horizontal notch and compact carried-forward ID. If an ID must be initialized, use 'REC-01' strictly as an illustrative identifier. Rail label: 'STORED VOTE RECORD — SEPARATE LAYER'. No connector from this token to the booth.
WORD SYNC  W290 → f2–24: begin the booth and outside-marker arrival immediately, using a frame-driven spring with damping 14 and stiffness 160. Complete the opacity reveal and restrained 18px lift by f24; secondary spring settling may continue without delaying readability.
           W295 → f69–134: establish the full headline and tighten the coral focus outline around the still-unlabeled outside marker. Do not introduce a ledger-security failure graphic.
           W296 → f131–159: spring in 'POTENTIAL OUTSIDE PRESSURE', resolve the marker to coral #FF5A36 and accent the fixed 'COERCION' kicker. Hold the reveal through the ensuing narration pause.
           W299 → f227–246: reveal 'VOTER POSITION' beside the neutral interior disc. Leave the work surface blank.
           W303 → f262–312: finish revealing the polling-booth floor, rear panel, work surface, threshold and partly raised side partitions; complete the camera track to the intervening wall.
           W305 → f339–368: extend both side partitions to their full protective height, keeping the entrance gap legible. Begin the wide pullback; no barrier animation originates at the record token.
           W306 → f368–400: draw the outside sightline progressively until it stops at the partition. Reveal 'PHYSICAL SEPARATION' and the amber qualification; finish the pullback at zoom 1.0 by f400.
           W309 → f416–446: briefly brighten the outside disc and its labeled badge, identifying the spatial source of potential pressure without drawing a person or asserting actual coercion.
           W314 → f487–507: send one restrained coral pulse along the existing sightline; it reaches the wall and stops by f507. No bounce, breach or green success state.
           W316 → f509–529: gently emphasize the inner disc and blank work surface, completing the distinction between the protected voting position and the separate stored-record rail. All semantic reveals are complete by f529.
AVOID  People, faces, ballot boxes, candidate choices, padlocks, chains or decorative circuit theater. · Suggesting that blockchain, the record token or record verification creates the physical privacy barrier. · Implying polling stations universally eliminate coercion or that the outside position necessarily represents an actual coercer. · Blue physical partitions, emerald privacy checks or unlabeled coral warnings. · Sharp panel corners, gray-on-gray styling, heavy perspective, camera roll or any zoom above 1.3. · Clipped labels, invented statistics, altered narration, estimated word boundaries, random flicker or perpetual bouncing. · Removing the partition during this shot or previewing the next sentence's home scenario.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_16: Replace the previous booth's interrupted sightline with a clear path from a nearby observer to a home-voting screen. A pressure bracket indicates attempted direction without changing any choice; a wider sightline subsequently exposes the entire display. The separate record token never functions as a privacy barrier.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  An unobstructed sightline makes the distinction unavoidable: protecting a stored vote record does not protect the voter from someone nearby directing or inspecting the choice. Present a hypothetical home scenario, not an inevitable outcome.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 634 frames. Dark investigation stage at x115, y170, width1690, height850, borderRadius24. Fix the headline at x120, y82 and kicker at x122, y139, outside the stage camera. Inside the stage, arrange a shallow three-quarter laptop with display bounds x850–1260, y330–570 and base extending to y730. Place the voter-position disc at (805,720) and potential-observer disc at (650,800), visibly behind the voter along the laptop's depth axis. Keep all moving diagram content and attached labels within x450–1450, y290–860. Pin an amber scenario qualifier near the stage's upper-left and the recurring blue record token on a separate lower footer rail.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> only on the internal diagram; headline, stage shell, qualifier, and footer remain fixed. Define centered mapping p'=(960,540)+zoom*((p-(960,540))+(camX,camY)). Begin at zoom1.0, offsets(0,0). F94–114 ease to zoom1.04, offsets(10,-5), introducing the home setting. F183–263 track toward the rear position at zoom1.10, offsets(55,-20). F276–297 travel toward the screen, ending zoom1.16, offsets(-35,0). F343–396 push into the direction bracket, ending zoom1.22, offsets(-70,10). F441–482 widen to zoom1.15, offsets(-35,0); F523–589 pull back to zoom1.0, offsets(0,0), retaining both positions and the whole display. Hold through f633. All pans stay at zoom≤1.2 except the centered pressure-detail push. At the maximum push, the diagram envelope maps to approximately x252–1472, y247–943; reserve additional room for restrained spring overshoot. No roll or extreme perspective.
TYPE  Headline: 'Who else can see the screen?' in 52px semibold off-white, fixed throughout. Kicker: 'VOTING FROM HOME' in 20px tracked uppercase. Functional labels use 24–28px medium type; the amber qualifier uses 22px. Bring labels in as whole units with brief opacity and 8px translation, never typewriter text or speech bubbles. Preserve the narration verbatim; no extra dialogue, full-screen quotation, or oversized decorative numerals.
COLOR/LIGHT  Use a rich gradient from #050B18 through #101B35 to #15102B, restrained electric-blue #0066FF illumination on the record infrastructure, and coral #FF5A36 exclusively for labeled potential pressure and screen access. Amber #F59E0B qualifies the hypothetical scenario. Neutral laptop geometry uses luminous slate edges and off-white highlights. Every floating slab or label has a color-matched soft glow; all visible rectangular surfaces use borderRadius20–28px. Keep grid opacity near 0.05, deterministic noise near 0.025, and the sightline wedge near 0.12 so relationships remain legible. No emerald check: no record verification occurs in this shot.
ELEMENTS  Five-layer stack: multi-stop midnight gradient → subtle <mg.GridBackground> → radial blue spotlight → rounded glass stage and diagram containers → low-opacity <mg.Noise>. Add four restrained <mg.Marker> registration crosses. · Exactly twelve clean schematic SVG elements: display shell, inner screen, hinge, base, keyboard slab, trackpad, desk edge, voter-position disc, observer-position disc, and three sightline components comprising two boundary strokes and one translucent wedge. Use rounded silhouettes, 20–28px rectangle radii, and rounded line caps; no people, faces, room illustration, or detailed keys. · Place the laptop in a rounded glass wrapper with backdrop-filter: blur(14px), background: rgba(15,23,42,0.85), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10), and boxShadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25). Keep the perspective shallow and fixed. · Screen interface: a DOM overlay clipped to the inner display, containing three identical blank rounded choice rows with empty circular controls. No candidate names, selection, readable ballot content, receipt, or identity information. · Position markers remain neutral white outlines. Attach 'VOTER POSITION' to the near disc and a coral glass label 'POTENTIAL OBSERVER' to the rear disc. The observer is hypothetical, not an identified person. · A coral <mg.FocusFrame> pressure bracket labeled 'DIRECTION' approaches the screen's choice region without touching a control. Later, a separate rounded frame labeled 'SCREEN ACCESS' encloses the entire display. Coral containers use boxShadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(255,90,54,0.2). · Keep 'HYPOTHETICAL HOME SCENARIO' visible in amber throughout. Carry the existing blue rounded record token, its short horizontal notch, and unchanged compact ID on a footer rail labeled 'STORED RECORD — SEPARATE LAYER'; do not connect the observer to the record ID.
WORD SYNC  W317 → F2 begin the rounded hero panel and laptop arrival using spring damping14, stiffness160. Establish the headline, amber qualifier, and inherited record token by f11; keep entrance overshoot below 6px.
           W322 → F94–114 bring the neutral blank ballot rows and 'VOTER POSITION' to full contrast while the camera makes its first shallow push. Do not select a row.
           W324 → F156–184 trace the first open sightline boundary toward the display. Show the absence of an interruption without adding a literal barrier or an invented security claim.
           W325 → F183–208 reveal the rear neutral disc and coral 'POTENTIAL OBSERVER' label with the same restrained spring.

           W331 → F276–297 send one coral pulse packet along the unobstructed sightline and finish the camera track at the display. No looping particles.
           W332 → F343–358 reveal the coral pressure bracket and 'DIRECTION' label beside the identical blank choice rows. Begin the detail push without changing the interface.
           W335 → F370–396 advance the bracket toward the choice region and stop visibly short of the controls. Complete the zoom1.22 push; all choices remain blank and unselected.
           W337 → F441–482 reduce the direction bracket to secondary emphasis and begin widening the view to restore the observer-to-display relationship.
           W338 → F523–548 expand the sightline wedge from the choice region toward the entire display and reveal 'SCREEN ACCESS'.
           W341 → F561–589 complete the rounded coral frame around the entire display and finish the wide pullback. Show the observer, voter position, exposed screen, amber qualifier, and separate record rail together.
AVOID  Selected candidates, invented dialogue, visible receipts, identity-to-choice links, or election statistics. · Treating the record token as proof of identity, privacy, or a freely cast vote. · Depicting a hypothetical observer as a confirmed coercer or implying all home voting is coerced. · A physical partition, stopped sightline, protective shield, or successful-verification check in this home scenario. · Decorative technology meshes, room props, human silhouettes, extra SVG illustrations, or oversized ghost text competing with the mechanism. · Sharp rectangular corners, flat gray styling, random flicker, continuous bouncing, camera roll, or zoom above1.22. · Replaying booth narration or previewing the next shot's conditional claim.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_18: A claim passes through a documentary inspection plate. A traveling aperture isolates its absolute wording; the verdict applies to that wording, while the stored record remains intact below.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Inspect the absolute word 'impossible' in an explicitly attributed cybersecurity claim, then reject that absolute without depicting a breach or dismissing record protection.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 542 frames. Light investigation stage: a 1690x850px rounded plate at x115 y150, beneath the fixed headline 'A claim too absolute' and kicker 'CYBERSECURITY'. Use one oversized inspection mechanism, not a terminal or card cascade. Inside the plate, place a broad input ribbon at x300 y270 w1240 h115, a quotation row at x330 y425 w1180 h120, an evidence rail at x330 y585 w1180 h85, and a deep qualification tray at x330 y700 w1180 h170. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_19: A tight protection contour surrounds only the stored-record layer inside the ledger chamber; a much larger election-system perimeter encompasses all seven nodes. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_17: A two-domain dossier: verification can inspect the blue stored-record token, but its pulse cannot cross into or erase external pressure. A dashed, amber-qualified route toward an opaque demonstration window introduces a possible coercion mechanism, not a universal blockchain feature.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  A successful record check leaves pressure around the voter unresolved. A separate, explicitly conditional branch explains how demonstrable voting evidence could make coercion easier without implying that every blockchain system exposes such evidence.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 422 frames. Light-theme consequence dossier. Keep the headline 'Verifiable does not mean voluntary' at x116, y82 and kicker 'A CONDITIONAL RISK' at x116, y134, independent of the stage camera. Hero stage: x115, y165, 1690x825px. Inside it, arrange an upper 'DIGITAL VERIFICATION' slab at x330, y235, 1260x190px; lower 'RECORD CHECK' slab at x330, y465, 520x385px; and 'PRESSURE AROUND THE VOTER' slab at x900, y465, 690x385px. Use 24px radii throughout. The upper slab reserves a large amber condition strip; the pressure slab contains a broad opaque evidence window and coral consequence label. No illustrative SVG.
CAMERA  Use deterministic <mg.CameraRig> motion around focal point (960,550), with fixed headline and kicker. Frames 0–25: begin at zoom 1.15, x0, y0 and ease x to +65 to favor the record slab. Frames 26–60: track x from +65 to -65 at zoom 1.15, moving attention to the unchanged pressure window. Hold through f100. Frames 101–191: ease to zoom 1.12, x0, y-20, centering the verification header. Frames 192–257: subtle push to zoom 1.15 around the same focal point. Frames 274–377: pull back smoothly to zoom 1.0, x0, y0, exposing the complete conditional route and qualifier. Frames 378–421: settled reading hold. Use the center-pivot transform p'=c+(p-c+offset)*zoom; with critical content inside x330–1590, y235–850, the maximum framing retains approximately x161–1759 and y165–895. No roll, perspective swing, or headline scaling.
TYPE  Use a premium sans-serif: headline 46px semibold, kicker 18px with restrained tracking, slab headings 24px, outcome labels 29–32px, condition 26px across two lines. Critical text stays within padded slab interiors. Start hero entrance at f2 using a frame-derived spring with damping 14 and stiffness 160, limiting positional overshoot to 8px; key labels become fully readable by f25. Use short opacity-and-8px translation reveals, not typewriter text or word spraying. Keep 'RECORD CHECK ONLY' explicitly attached to its emerald check. Emphasize the conditional words IF and MAY through weight and amber/coral treatment, not enlarged standalone slogans.
COLOR/LIGHT  Keep the overall scene unmistakably light: background linear-gradient(125deg,#F8FBFF 0%,#EAF2FF 52%,#F1F8FF 100%), navy typography, luminous white outer stage. Use compact dark-glass slabs for contrast rather than a dark canvas. Electric blue #0066FF denotes record infrastructure; emerald #10B981 appears only with the labeled record check; coral #FF5A36 denotes unresolved pressure and the conditional risk; amber #F59E0B carries the qualifier. Use blue glow rgba(0,102,255,0.25), emerald rgba(16,185,129,0.20), and coral rgba(255,90,54,0.20), each at 0 20px 60px. Grid and noise remain subtle and deterministic. Every visible rectangle has 20–28px corner radii.
ELEMENTS  Five-layer stack: pearl-to-ice-blue multi-stop gradient; subtle electric-blue <mg.GridBackground>; broad radial spotlight behind the dossier; glass content containers; fine <mg.Noise> overlay. Add restrained <mg.Marker> crosshairs at stage margins. · Upper digital-verification slab with dark frosted inset: background rgba(15,23,42,0.85), backdropFilter blur(14px), border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10), borderRadius 24px, boxShadow 0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25). Reserve two lines for the condition so nothing reflows. · Record slab containing the persistent electric-blue rounded rectangle, short horizontal notch, and unchanged compact record ID inherited from the previous shot. Do not invent a new ID. A functional scan resolves to an emerald check explicitly labeled 'RECORD CHECK ONLY'. · Pressure slab retaining the prior shot's coral screen-access frame, now around an entirely opaque window. Labels: 'SCREEN ACCESS' and 'UNRESOLVED'. No person, selected candidate, receipt content, identity field, or identity-to-choice mapping. · A blue verification connector terminates inside the record slab. Its traveling packet never reaches the pressure slab. A separate dashed branch runs from the upper slab toward the opaque pressure window; rounded dash caps distinguish its conditional meaning. · Amber condition: 'IF A PERSON CAN BE MADE TO DEMONSTRATE A CHOICE'. Coral destination: 'COERCION MAY BECOME EASIER'. Both remain visible together after the final pullback. Apply color-matched glow shadows to every floating slab and inset panel.
WORD SYNC  W342 → F2–25: dossier enters and the inherited record token settles in the record slab. Complete the compact scan and emerald 'RECORD CHECK ONLY' reveal by f25.

AVOID  Treating a verified stored record as proof of voter identity, privacy, or freedom from coercion. · A solid or unconditional route implying all blockchain voting exposes demonstrable choice evidence. · Revealing a receipt, candidate selection, identity-to-choice mapping, or hidden content through the opaque evidence window. · Illustrative SVG heroes, shields, padlocks, code rain, percentages, statistics, counters, or decorative technology meshes. · Sharp-cornered panels, gray-on-gray styling, flat unlit cards, or an overall dark theme. · Zoom above 1.3, unsafe pans, camera roll, headline drift, random flicker, repeated bouncing, or transitions that overlap narration coverage. · Previewing the next shot's cybersecurity assertion or presenting the conditional consequence as a universal conclusion.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_20: An exploded endpoint-device assembly exposes four distinct physical or functional surfaces, not a chain reaction. One coral inspection frame visits them in spoken order. Small local interruptions suggest possible weaknesses without depicting successful attacks. The recurring blue record token remains unchanged on a separate ledger rail.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Four independently conditional risks sit upstream of an intact stored vote record. Protecting that record does not establish the security of the phone, computer, application, or identity system.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 585 frames; light editorial shot. Lock the headline 'Four places risk can enter' and kicker 'BEFORE THE LEDGER' at x116 above the stage, independent of camera motion. Place a 1690x850px rounded stage at x115,y150. Within stage-local coordinates, place VOTING APPLICATION at (245,90), 475x205; IDENTITY SYSTEM at (770,90), 475x205; a front-facing phone at (335,390), 230x390; and a desktop monitor assembly at (745,385), 500x395. Together, the device silhouettes anchor the lower two-thirds. Reserve a narrow ledger rail at (1390,130), 215x610. Keep labels inset and all resting content within the canvas safe zone. Footer: 'CONCEPTUAL SURFACES — NOT A PROTOCOL'.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only, with a fixed centered transform origin at stage-local (845,425). Interpolate zoom/x/y keyframes: f0 (1.00,0,0); f29 (1.07,+30,-15), gently favoring the phone; f66 hold; f150 (1.06,0,-15), tracking right to the computer; f189 hold; f296 (1.04,+20,+10), rising toward the application; f361 hold; f474 (1.00,0,0), pulling back to include identity and the full context; then hold through f585. Use smooth eased interpolation, never roll. Check complete bounding boxes with screen = stageOrigin + origin + (local + offset - origin)*zoom. At the closest keyframe the ledger rail remains approximately x1575–1805, and critical content stays inside x100–1820,y80–1000. The headline never scales.
TYPE  Use a crisp documentary grotesk: headline 46px semibold, kicker 19px tracked uppercase, surface labels 27–30px, coral condition labels 24–27px, footer 20px, record ID 20px monospace. Break long condition labels into two balanced lines without shrinking them. Keep 'CAN' equally prominent so every risk remains conditional. Reveal labels as complete phrases rather than typewriter text. Surface entrances begin at f3 with spring damping:14, stiffness:160 and a restrained 12px vertical offset; clamp residual overshoot by the relevant cue end. No additional narration or statistics.
COLOR/LIGHT  Light canvas gradient: #F8FAFF through #EEF4FF to #FFFFFF. Use #0F172A typography, electric blue #0066FF exclusively for record infrastructure, restrained violet #8B5CF6 for neutral surface edges, and coral #FF5A36 plus explicit text for unresolved risks. No emerald verification marks are needed. Broad radial lighting and soft colored shadows separate the glass layers; never turn the whole shot dark. Every visible rectangular card, panel, slab, SVG shell, or container has 20–28px corners; fine rules use rounded caps. Noise remains subtle and deterministic.
ELEMENTS  Five-layer stack: warm-white multi-stop gradient → low-opacity <mg.GridBackground> → broad blue radial spotlight → rounded glass stage and surface containers → subtle <mg.Noise> overlay. Add restrained <mg.Marker> crosshairs at assembly registration points. · Build the combined device illustration from exactly twelve clean SVG primitives: phone outer shell, screen, earpiece, home indicator, status rule, interruption dash; monitor bezel, screen, neck, base, status rule, interruption dash. Use rounded rectangles throughout, minimum 20px corner radius; capsule details use fully rounded ends. No illustrative symbols beyond these two devices. · Use CSS geometry for the two detached software planes. Each has borderRadius:24px, backdropFilter:'blur(14px)', background:'rgba(15,23,42,0.85)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10)', and a restrained violet glow. Apply the same glass treatment to important inspection containers while keeping the overall stage bright. · Phone and computer sit within rounded frosted mounting containers with saturated violet edge accents and boxShadow:'0 20px 60px rgba(139,92,246,0.16)'. Short neutral registration lines connect each device to its own mounting plane; no arrows or animated packets run between the four risk surfaces. · One rounded coral <mg.FocusFrame> relocates between surfaces. Persistent labeled callouts read 'CAN BE HACKED', 'CAN BE INFECTED', 'CAN HAVE VULNERABILITIES', and 'CAN BE COMPROMISED'. Each callout uses a localized coral dash and boxShadow:'0 20px 60px rgba(255,90,54,0.2)'. · Ledger rail: rounded glass container labeled 'LEDGER / STORED RECORD'. Retain the inherited blue rounded token, its short horizontal notch, and its existing compact record ID. Use #0066FF and boxShadow:'0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25)'. Do not add an identity badge, safety check, or unqualified security claim.

           W391 → Across f12–29, settle the phone entrance, complete the gentle phone-biased camera push, and seat the coral focus frame around the phone.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_23: A goal-selection routing table with its destination missing. The tool is present, but its suitability remains unassessed until the desired outcome is defined.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Reverse the usual tool-first presentation: trace backward from blockchain to an undefined election objective, making assessment contingent on defining the problem without accepting or rejecting the tool.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 347 frames. Light investigation stage, 1690x850px at x115 y170 with borderRadius:24px. Fixed headline at x120 y82, 'Start with the problem'; kicker above, 'THE DESIGN QUESTION'. Inside the stage, keep critical content within x280–1620, y300–880: an empty objective socket at x280 y310, 400x190px; an uncommitted connector through the center; and a proposed-tool module at x1190 y310, 430x190px. Below, three 1340x96px evidence rows at x280 and y560/672/784 read 'ELECTION PROBLEM', 'REQUIRED OUTCOME', and 'FIT TO BE ASSESSED', each paired with an empty neutral value field. All visible rectangular elements have 20–28px corner radii.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only, with transformOrigin:'960px 540px'; headline and kicker remain fixed. Begin at zoom1.15, x-80, y0, spotlighting the tool. Frames20–123 ease backward along the connector to zoom1.10, x+60, y0, shifting attention to the empty objective. Hold during frames124–170. Frames171–290 pull back continuously to zoom1.0, x0, y0, revealing all three blank assessment fields. Hold the resolved wide layout through frame346. Check transformed bounds using center-relative coordinates: at the opening pose, critical horizontal bounds map to approximately x86–1627, so retain x100 safety by limiting the opening pan to x-65 instead; resulting bounds are approximately x103–1644. Use x-65 as the actual opening offset. No roll, camera shake, or decorative zoom pulses.
TYPE  Use a premium neutral grotesk: headline 46px semibold, kicker 17px tracked uppercase, module labels 25–28px, evidence labels 26px, objective query 60px bold. Dark navy type on light glass, blue only for record infrastructure, amber for the unresolved prerequisite. Type 'WHAT' during W467 and ' PROBLEM?' during W468; finish by frame212 with no blinking cursor. Keep evidence labels steady and fully legible; emphasize their relationships through brackets and connector movement rather than bouncing text.
COLOR/LIGHT  Warm white #F8FAFC through pale blue-white #EEF4FF to white, dark navy #0F172A typography, saturated electric blue #0066FF exclusively for the record/tool infrastructure, amber #F59E0B for 'DEFINE FIRST' and prerequisite focus. Broad soft white spotlight shifts from the tool to the objective with the camera. Subtle slate grid, deterministic low-opacity grain, restrained blue and amber glow shadows. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_21: A changed payload crosses one recording boundary and becomes a durable mismatch. The ledger preserves B; the unchanged reference still says A. This is an event path, not a measured timeline or a demonstration of an actual attack.
pipelineLogs.detail:

COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 576 frames. Fixed headline at (116,80): 'The wrong input can become the record'; kicker above: 'THE CRITICAL FAILURE MODE'. Establish three broad CSS server bays, then recompose into a 1450px horizontal causal trajectory from x235 to x1685 at y665. A tall recording boundary at x1120 separates 'BEFORE RECORDING' from 'AFTER RECORDING'. The stationary 'INTENDED A' reference sits on an upper comparison rail near (700,420); the selection changes near (760,665), crosses the boundary, and becomes a stored record centered near (1320,665). Keep semantic labels within x380–1470, y360–860, comfortably inside the stage during camera motion. Peripheral trajectory ends carry no critical text.

The server hero starts entering at f2 with spring damping 14 and stiffness 160; its identifying label is fully readable by f24. Clamp entrances at cue deadlines. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_22: A recording event separates two different inspection questions. A successful check on the stored token does not travel backward into a guarantee about its input. The scope band describes that limited inference; it is not a software barrier.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Separate protection of a stored vote record from confidence in the input that produced it. Two questions remain visible across one recording boundary: record integrity can be protected; input correctness is not established by that protection.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 611 frames. Fixed top-left kicker 'THE KEY DISTINCTION' at (115,82) and headline 'Integrity is not input correctness' at (115,113), independent of the stage camera. Light editorial hero stage: x115, y150, 1690x850, borderRadius 28px. Two 700x610 glass cards sit at x210 and x1010, y285, separated by the inherited recording boundary at x960, y255–935. One narrow rounded transfer slot crosses the boundary at y570. Keep each card's text inside x270–850 or x1070–1650. A thin scope annotation occupies only the right half and terminates at the boundary. Footer at y955: 'INPUT MAY BE CORRECT — THE LEDGER DOES NOT ESTABLISH IT'.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only. Frames 0–64 start near the inherited right-hand check at zoom 1.04, x -24, y -10; reveal the clean light comparison view with restrained drift. Frames 106–213 ease to zoom 1.08, x -42, y -15, centered around the stored token; hold through frame 328. Frames 374–447 track left as the coral focus frame moves upstream, easing to zoom 1.03, x +18, y -10. Frames 483–565 pull back to zoom 1.0, x0, y0 so both questions and the qualifier coexist; hold through frame 590. Ease with smooth deterministic frame interpolation, no roll. At the tightest pose, the card bounds under the conservative transform are x181–1801 and y292–950; critical labels remain farther inset. Never crop either question, never scale the fixed headline, and never exceed 1.08 in this shot.
TYPE  Use a clean documentary grotesk, dark navy on the light stage. Kicker 16px tracked uppercase; headline 38px semibold; card headers 23px; question text 36px with deliberate two-line breaks; outcome badges 27px; qualifier 22px. Start the card spring arrivals at frame 2 with damping 14, stiffness 160 and only 12px vertical travel. Complete the comparison structure by frame 64. Reveal semantic phrases as whole units with short masked wipes, not character scrambling. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_24: A paper-evidence source supports several independent oversight paths, not a mandatory sequential pipeline. Observation opens sightlines to public process windows; auditing branches into review; recounting follows a separate return loop; verifiable procedures expose an inspection surface. Together these relationships make public scrutiny legible without exposing anyone's private vote.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Transparency is a conditional election goal supported by complementary mechanisms already available in traditional systems. Reveal tangible evidence and distinct oversight paths without implying that any mechanism guarantees a flawless election.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 682 frames. Light-theme mesh stage at x115, y145, w1690, h850. Fix the headline 'Transparency has existing mechanisms' and kicker 'EVIDENCE AND PUBLIC SCRUTINY' above the stage, independent of its camera. Carry the previous shot's empty objective socket into an amber-outlined conditional header, 'IF THE GOAL IS TRANSPARENCY'. Within the stage, place PAPER BALLOTS at (225,410), 350x335; OBSERVERS at (645,300), 300x130; AUDITS at (665,490), 300x150; RECOUNTS at (645,700), 300x135; PUBLICLY VERIFIABLE PROCEDURES at (1040,400), 345x335; and PUBLIC SCRUTINY at (1440,430), 290x235. All coordinates are absolute at rest. Bottom caption: 'COMPLEMENTARY MECHANISMS — CONCEPTUAL VIEW'. Park the recurring blue record token on a separate lower-right 'PROPOSED TOOL — SEPARATE RAIL', physically disconnected from the paper network. Keep future stations invisible until their spoken cues.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only, with no roll or perspective. F0–90: start at zoom1.08, x0, y0, easing toward 1.04 while the inherited objective socket resolves; the still-unlabeled paper mounting panel is the initial spatial anchor. F113–274: settle to zoom1.0 and begin a conservative rightward stage translation. F274–322: x+65, y-20, zoom1.01 gently privileges the revealed paper assembly. F342–433: track toward observation and review, x+35→+15, y+20→0, zoom1.01; panels themselves remain stationary. F459–499: dip toward the recount loop using x0, y-30, zoom1.01. F518–634: smoothly return to zoom1.0, x0, y0, revealing the right-side inspection surface and full conditional frame. F635–681: hold the complete mesh with a minimal 1.0→1.005 centered drift. Use the stage center (960,570) as transform origin and validate each revealed panel's full bounds, including shadows, through every frame; camera offsets remain within ±65px horizontally and ±30px vertically.
TYPE  Use a precise documentary grotesk: headline 43px semibold, kicker 17px tracked uppercase, station labels 27–30px semibold, explanatory labels 20–22px. Dark navy text on light glass; white text only inside localized dark inspection windows. Conditional header is 30px with amber emphasis on 'IF'; no guarantee language. Break 'PUBLICLY VERIFIABLE PROCEDURES' into three intentional lines. Reveal words through rounded masks rather than scrambled characters. No rolling metrics or invented counts. Panel entrances use frame-driven spring damping14, stiffness160, short 12–18px travel and restrained overshoot, settling by the associated spoken end.
COLOR/LIGHT  Background gradient: #F8FAFF through #EDF3FF to #FFF3E6, with navy #0F172A typography and low-opacity slate grid lines. Broad warm-white radial spotlight grounds the paper evidence; a restrained violet #8B5CF6 edge glow separates review glass. Saturated amber #F59E0B identifies the conditional goal, not a guarantee. Electric blue #0066FF is reserved exclusively for the disconnected record-infrastructure token. Use no emerald checks, coral failure coding or blue network packets. Fine noise stays subtle enough to preserve the clean paper finish.
ELEMENTS  Required depth stack: luminous multi-stop background gradient → restrained <mg.GridBackground> → broad radial spotlight → rounded glass content panels → subtle deterministic <mg.Noise> overlay. Add four quiet <mg.Marker> registration points around the stage. · Use borderRadius:24px for every visible panel, frame, rail, packet and rectangular SVG outline. Main stage glass: rgba(255,255,255,0.74), backdropFilter:'blur(14px)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.70)'. Important audit and procedure inspection insets use rgba(15,23,42,0.85), backdropFilter:'blur(14px)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10)', remaining localized dark glass within a clearly light shot. · One iconic paper-ballot SVG assembly only: exactly three offset rounded sheet outlines, three neutral rounded checkbox outlines, three text rules and one fold line. Use broad, clean strokes with round caps. No marked choice, identifier, envelope or ballot box. Its mounting panel begins entering at f2; the recognizable evidence assembly remains masked until W488. · Observers are a CSS panel with slate sightline brackets aimed only at windows labeled 'PROCESS REVIEW' and 'PROCEDURE INSPECTION'. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_25: A technology-label testing instrument: a recognizable blockchain label enters the apparatus, but its name alone cannot fill the evidence field. The amber aperture qualifies the inference rather than condemning the technology. A larger election-evaluation tray ultimately supersedes this narrow test.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  A technology name cannot establish election security. Show an unsupported inference stopping short of a security claim, then redirect attention toward the broader, still-unfilled election requirements.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 524 frames. Light investigation stage at x115,y170,w1690,h850, borderRadius:24px. Fixed headline at x115,y80: 'A name is not a security guarantee'; kicker: 'THE ELECTION STANDARD'. Within the stage, place a blue-glowing BLOCKCHAIN nameplate at x325,y290,w440,h280, an amber qualification aperture at x860,y340,w260,h190, and a coral-outlined 'MORE SECURE?' evidence field at x1220,y310,w400,h250. A narrow separate rail beneath the nameplate carries the recurring blue record token. A CSS claim carriage connects left toward right without completing the inference. Reserve x320,y650,w1300,h240 for the later 'ELECTION REQUIREMENTS' tray. All panels and rectangular geometry have 20–28px rounded corners.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only; headline and kicker remain fixed. Frames 0–27: focal-centered push from zoom 1.08 to 1.15 around the nameplate at (545,430), with no extra translation. Frames 29–131: ease the focal point toward (960,430) while relaxing zoom to 1.08 and tracking x from 0 to -45px along the claim carriage. Frames 150–233: settle at x:-35px, keeping the aperture and empty evidence field together. Frames 274–414: follow the carriage downward while pulling back to zoom:1,x:0,y:0. Frames 437–474: restrained push to 1.02 around the expanded tray; hold through frame 523. Interpolate focal changes continuously, no roll. Validate projected bounds of every critical label throughout; keep screen-space content within x100–1820,y80–1000.
TYPE  Use a premium sans serif with tabular record ID. Headline 46px semibold; kicker 18px tracked; BLOCKCHAIN 52px; field and tray labels 32–36px; secondary labels 22px. Reveal phrases as complete units, not typewriter letters. The nameplate begins entering at frame 2 with spring damping:14,stiffness:160 and restrained overshoot, settling by frame 27. 'NOT AUTOMATIC' and 'MORE SECURE?' carry the argument; avoid animated narration subtitles. Keep every label upright and crisp.
COLOR/LIGHT  Maintain a clearly light shot: background gradient #F8FAFF to #E6F0FF with a restrained #DCE7FF violet-blue edge. Electric blue #0066FF means record infrastructure only. Amber #F59E0B qualifies the inference; coral #FF5A36 plus 'MORE SECURE?' identifies the unresolved question. No emerald verification check is warranted. Use broad soft illumination, fine grid contrast, minimal noise, and restrained colored glows rather than neon bloom.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_26: A bento requirements dossier, not a scorecard: seven equally authoritative fields dock into one common brace. Short neutral tabs connect each field to the envelope, never to another requirement. The broad bottom ribbon is another requirement, not a defensive shield.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Seven election requirements accumulate within one shared system envelope. Retaining every requirement makes their conjunctive relationship unmistakable: strength in one field cannot substitute for another.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 706 frames. Light editorial dossier. Fixed top-left kicker 'SIMULTANEOUS REQUIREMENTS' at (116,82), headline 'Seven demands. One election.' at (116,119); both remain outside the stage camera. Expand the inherited ELECTION REQUIREMENTS tray into a 1690x850 stage at (115,170). Three interlocking glass slabs occupy x=280–710, 745–1175, and 1210–1640, y=305–665. Each contains two equal 382x136 inset fields at y=329 and 497. Left: ACCURATE COUNTING / VOTER AUTHENTICATION. Middle: BALLOT SECRECY / RESISTANCE TO COERCION. Right: ACCESSIBILITY / AUDITABILITY. A seventh ribbon occupies (280,709), 1360x136. An encompassing rounded brace at (250,270), 1420x610, carries 'REQUIRED TOGETHER'. Keep all seven fields equally legible and permanently present after their reveals.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only, with a true centered pivot at (960,575), no roll or perspective. Frames 0–52 push from zoom 1.00 to 1.10, x=70, y=8, toward the left slab. Frames 504–570 dip toward the bottom ribbon, easing to zoom 1.06, x=0, y=-35. Frames 632–658 pull back to zoom 1.00, x=0, y=0, revealing the complete envelope; frames 658–705 hold with a restrained 1.00-to-1.015 ambient push. TYPE  Headline: 48px semibold editorial sans; kicker: 18px uppercase with restrained tracking. Requirement labels: 30px semibold, consistent two-line wrapping where needed, no size hierarchy. 'REQUIRED TOGETHER': 22px semibold. Each complete phrase enters as one unit with an 8px upward translation and opacity spring, damping 14, stiffness 160. Reveal full phrases at their first word, settle by their final supplied word end, then retain without dimming. No word-by-word scrambling, counters, badges, or success ticks.
COLOR/LIGHT  Bright multi-stop background #F7FAFF → #E4EEFF → #FFFFFF, ink typography #0F172A, white text inside dark glass. Electric blue #0066FF is confined to record infrastructure, stage edging, and the retained token; saturated blue glows provide depth without a dark full-screen grade. No coral failure marks, amber guarantees, or unlabeled status colors. Noise is subtle and frame-deterministic; spotlight illumination remains calm.

pipelineLogs.message: Shot_27: A locally useful input feeding one bounded subsystem, not powering or completing the whole election. The seven requirements remain neutral and equally necessary; unlit means not established here, not failing. Use functional CSS panels and curved conduit paths, with no illustrative entity or literal puzzle pieces.
pipelineLogs.detail:

COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 417 frames; light-theme system mesh. Lock the headline at (116,82) and kicker at (116,140), independent of the stage camera. Place a 1690x810px rounded glass stage at (115,190). Inside, arrange seven equal-authority requirement pills around a central ELECTION SYSTEM surface at (640,440), 640x260px. Side pills: RESISTANCE TO COERCION at (210,440), ACCESSIBILITY at (1340,440), AUDITABILITY at (1340,590), each 300x120px. Place SECURITY AGAINST LARGE-SCALE ATTACKS at (210,750), 590x110px. The eighth node, POTENTIAL BLOCKCHAIN CONTRIBUTION, sits at (865,810), 650x100px. Independently route the seven neutral conduits into the central surface; never connect requirements sequentially. Within the system, confine blue activity to a 380x110px inset at (880,565), labeled RECORD LAYER / CAN HELP. Reserve the lower margin for CONCEPTUAL SCOPE — NOT A PROTOCOL.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> only on the stage, with a stage viewport mask protecting the fixed header. Set the camera pivot to (960,590); screen mapping is pivot + (point − pivot + offset) × zoom. Begin at zoom 1.15, offset (−35,−15), gently favoring the record-layer area. During f62–156 ease to zoom 1.18, offset (−50,−20), tracking the pulse into the inset. During f202–286 track its upper scope boundary to offset (−20,−25), zoom 1.15. Pull back over f314–370 to zoom 1.0 and zero offsets, completing the contextual reveal on W546. At the closest view, critical assembly bounds x210–1660/y250–950 project to approximately x16​?; use the explicit verified bounds x16​? only as a production check is not permitted. Instead enforce projected critical bounds x100–1820/y200–1000 on every frame, reducing zoom or offset if necessary. Hold the wide context through f406; never roll or exceed 1.18.
TYPE  Headline: A contribution, not the whole solution, 46px semibold near-black; kicker: SCOPE MATTERS, 18px tracked electric blue. Requirement labels use 26–28px semibold, wrapped to two lines where needed, with equal weight and generous padding. ELECTION SYSTEM is 34px; RECORD LAYER / CAN HELP is 27px in white on dark glass. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_29: An acceptance rail with three jointly bracketed conditions. It borrows milestone geometry without chronological steps, rankings, scores, or axes. The rail cannot confer success: preserving all three essentials is part of the condition, and the stored record token provides no shortcut.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Solving the hard problems remains conditional on preserving ballot secrecy, security, and public trust together. Equal condition pillars show simultaneous requirements, not achievements or ranked results.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 422 frames. Light editorial stage, approximately 1690x850px at x115,y150, beneath a fixed top-left headline and kicker. A 1450px acceptance rail runs from x235 to1685 at y765. Place a broad 'SOLVE THE HARD PROBLEMS' carriage at x245,y520,w390,h200; three equal pillars at x700,1020,1340, each w260,h320, rest on the rail. A shared top brace spans x680–1620 at y340–416. Set an amber 'CONDITIONAL' endpoint tag near x1550,y795. Keep the recurring blue record token below the rail at x510,y865, physically disconnected from the endpoint. All visible panels, bars, tags, and containers have 20–28px corner radii; connectors use round caps.
CAMERA  Use <mg.CameraRig> on the stage only; headline and kicker remain screen-fixed. Start at zoom1.15, centered on the carriage, with pan x+35,y0. Ease to zoom1.08,x+10 by f124 as the rail and equal pillars enter view. On the shared condition phrase, make a brief centered push to zoom1.10,x-10,y+8 by f175, then ease to zoom1.06 by f197. Track the inspection focus left-to-right with conservative pan x+12→-12 during f193–374, at zoom1.04–1.06. Pull back to zoom1,x0,y0 by f398 and hold through f421. Compensate translation for focal-point zoom; validate every critical bounding box against x100–1820,y80–1000, including (edge+camOffset)*zoom. Keep all three pillars visible once established; never isolate one as sufficient.
TYPE  Fixed headline 'Without sacrificing the essentials' at x120,y82, 48px semibold dark navy; kicker 'THE CONDITIONS THAT MUST HOLD' at x122,y50, 17px uppercase with restrained tracking. Pillar labels use 30–34px semibold type and intentional two-line breaks where needed. All three labels appear together by f124, then receive phrase-specific emphasis through one neutral inspection band rather than separate success animations. Brace lettering is 26–28px; qualifiers and token caption remain at least 20px. No numeric axes, rankings, percentage counters, giant numerals, or additional narration.
COLOR/LIGHT  Keep the shot unmistakably light: multi-stop background #F8FAFF→#E5EFFF→#FFFFFF, dark navy typography, bright white frosted surfaces, and restrained blue ambient depth. Electric blue #0066FF identifies only the record token and inherited record infrastructure. Coral #FF5A36 appears with 'UNRESOLVED'; amber #F59E0B appears with 'CONDITIONAL'. Condition pillars use luminous neutral glass, not blue protection coding. Do not use emerald, because no record verification or broader success is being asserted. ELEMENTS  Five-layer stack: rich ivory-to-ice-blue gradient; restrained blue <mg.GridBackground>; broad radial white spotlight; glassmorphic stage and condition geometry; subtle <mg.Noise> overlay. · Inherited unresolved route enters the left carriage, retaining a coral 'UNRESOLVED' label. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_28: A scope selector corrects the question being answered. The upper route rejects 'NEVER USE'; the main route admits a limited record-layer contribution but stops before establishing system-wide sufficiency. The stop means 'not sufficient alone', not 'cannot contribute'.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  Separate a rejected categorical conclusion from a narrower sufficiency claim: blockchain is not excluded from elections, but a record-layer contribution alone does not solve their hardest problems.
COMPOSITION  1920x1080, 60fps, 619 frames. Light investigation stage, approximately 1690x850px at x115, y180. Keep critical content within x220–1700, y280–920; the lower stage margin is decorative only. Fix the compact headline 'Not never. Not enough alone.' and kicker 'THE PRECISE CONCLUSION' above the camera-controlled stage. Build one horizontal verdict-routing instrument: an ANSWER dock at left, a movable scope selector at the central junction, and a tall HARD ELECTION PROBLEMS destination at right. An upper rejected branch and a wider lower contribution route share the junction; this is one mechanism, not two comparison boards.
CAMERA  Keep headline and kicker outside <mg.CameraRig>. F0–48: gently push from zoom1.02 to1.06 around the stage center, translating x0→-15px, y0→20px to favor the rejected branch; sustain through f207. F251–354: track the selector downward while easing zoom1.06→1.03, x-15→0, y20→-10. F398–428: push to1.08 around the main carriage, x0→-25, y-10→-30; hold this close inspection through f480. F489–564: pull back to zoom1, x0, y0, revealing both the rejected route and the limited contribution within one frame. F565–618: nearly imperceptible drift to1.01. Use a centered transform origin and screen-space checks on complete element bounds, not just anchors. With critical content restricted to x220–1700, y280–920, this restrained motion preserves safe margins throughout.
TYPE  Use a premium documentary grotesk: fixed headline 48px semibold, kicker 19px uppercase with restrained tracking; route labels 26–30px, proposition 42px, destination header 30px on two lines, inherited tabs 23–25px. White type on dark glass and deep navy type on the light stage. Animate meaningful labels as complete phrases with short opacity-and-position reveals, not letter scrambles. NOT THE CONCLUSION must be settled before NEVER USE appears. ALONE and NOT SUFFICIENT remain visually distinct qualifications; no standalone 'BLOCKCHAIN DOESN'T WORK' wording. All primary arrivals begin immediately, with the dock entering at f2 using spring damping14, stiffness160 and restrained travel.
COLOR/LIGHT  Use a light multi-stop gradient from #F8FBFF through #E8F1FF to #FFF4EC, with a soft white spotlight behind the routing instrument. Electric blue #0066FF is confined to record infrastructure; coral #FF5A36 is accompanied by the explicit rejection or unresolved-scope text; amber #F59E0B qualifies ALONE and NOT SUFFICIENT. Neutral requirement tabs are descriptive, not washed-out failure indicators. No emerald verification marks are warranted here. Keep saturated accents crisp, grid opacity near0.05, noise near0.025, and glows controlled rather than neon.
ELEMENTS  Five-layer stack: luminous multi-stop background gradient → <mg.GridBackground> → radial spotlight → glassmorphic instrument and content → subtle <mg.Noise>. Add four restrained <mg.Marker> registration crosses outside reading areas. · Instrument shell at x115, y180, width1690, height850, borderRadius28. Use a translucent warm-white rounded backing with a restrained blue rim glow; nest important modules in glass with background rgba(15,23,42,0.85), backdropFilter blur(14px), and border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10). Keep the overall frame unmistakably light. · ANSWER dock at x250, y530, width230, height170. Central rounded selector housing at x550, y470, width230, height250. One amber scope band travels from the upper branch to the lower junction; it never duplicates. · Upper branch centered near x980, y385: coral text label NOT THE CONCLUSION above a neutral NEVER USE proposition tile. Reveal the rejection label before introducing the proposition. After correction, retract its active connector and retain the proposition at reduced luminance with its rejection label fully legible. · Main carriage at x810, y625, width285, height150. Preserve one blue record token from the previous shot: borderRadius20, short horizontal notch, and the same compact record ID. Add the separate amber qualifier ALONE; the token always denotes a stored vote record, not identity or free choice. · Destination field at x1260, y300, width420, height580. Header HARD ELECTION PROBLEMS; below it, seven compact neutral rounded requirement tabs using the exact inherited labels and ordering. No new requirements, failure marks, success checks, counts, or invented measures. · Place a small RECORD LAYER / CAN HELP inset at x1290, y750, width360, height90 within the destination's lower boundary. The blue route enters only this inset. An amber capped connector at its scope boundary reads NOT SUFFICIENT; no blue pulse continues into the seven requirement tabs. · Use CSS rails with fully rounded caps, clipped connector reveals, rounded masks, and traveling inspection bands. pipelineLogs.message: Shot_30: Two equally substantial cards separate the stored record from the act and conditions of voting. A bounded verification scan resolves the record beautifully; its connector ends at the scope gap instead of reaching the election conditions. Empty evidence slots mean not established here, not proven failure.
pipelineLogs.detail:
PREMISE  An impressive record system does not establish the quality of an election. Preserve the narration verbatim: "putting elections on blockchain might give us a very impressive database, while giving us a very unimpressive election."
COMPOSITION  1920×1080, 60fps, 567 frames. Light dual-comparison stage at x115, y150, 1690×850px beneath a camera-independent headline and kicker. Two equal 700×740px glass cards rest at x175 and x1045, y205, leaving a 170px scope gap. All panels, slots, tags and frames have 24px rounded corners. Left: DATABASE, an elegant blue database cylinder, the intact recurring record token in a separate functional record slot, an attached amber MIGHT qualifier, and a labeled record-only check. Right: ELECTION, retaining the previous shot's three equal condition fields: BALLOT SECRECY, SECURITY, PUBLIC TRUST. Each has an empty neutral evidence slot. Reserve a broad footer inside the stage for the scope statement and terminating connector. Five-layer stack: multistop light gradient, <mg.GridBackground>, radial spotlight, glass content, <mg.Noise>.
CAMERA  Use a focal-centered <mg.CameraRig> with the fixed headline outside its transform. Start at zoom1.24 focused on the database assembly near (570,525), x/y offsets 0; the unopened right card is not yet critical content. Begin the left-card spring at f2, damping14/stiffness160, settling by f78. F190–258 ease to zoom1.10 while retaining the database focus. F259–303 widen to zoom1.0 and recenter before revealing the comparison. On W598 'while', f304–323, track gently across the gap with x moving 0 to -24px at zoom1.0 as the right card unfolds. F389–424 make a restrained focal push to zoom1.02 around the election conditions, then return to zoom1.0, x0/y0 during f493–546. Hold through f566. Use focal-point compensation rather than scaling from the canvas origin; transformed critical labels must remain within x100–1820/y80–1000. Both complete cards and the intact token are visible for the final statement.
TYPE  Use a premium neutral sans-serif with crisp, high-contrast ink text. DATABASE and ELECTION are equal 42px headings; condition labels 30px; check, qualifier and status labels at least 25px. No typewriter effect or narration-as-subtitles. Reveal labels with their containing geometry, using only brief opacity and 8px vertical settling. 'MIGHT' remains attached to DATABASE, never transferred to the entire comparison. Wrap the coral status across two balanced lines inside the election card. Keep the headline unchanged throughout.
COLOR/LIGHT  Keep the overall shot unmistakably light: #F7FAFF → #E8F0FF → #FFFFFF background with a soft blue radial spotlight behind DATABASE. Electric blue #0066FF means record infrastructure only. Emerald #10B981 appears only with the labeled record check. Amber #F59E0B qualifies the database claim. Coral #FF5A36 labels unresolved election scope, with boxShadow:'0 20px 60px rgba(255,90,54,0.2)' on its focus treatment. Floating panels receive restrained colored glows; use deep navy text, not gray-on-gray. No red failure wash or celebratory green lighting.
ELEMENTS  Fixed headline at x115, y80: 'A database is not an election', 50px semibold. Compact kicker above: 'THE FINAL DISTINCTION', 18px tracked. · Light stage with borderRadius:24px, subtle architectural <mg.Marker> registration marks, restrained blue grid and low-opacity deterministic noise. · Two equal <mg.Card> containers with borderRadius:24px, backdropFilter:'blur(14px)', translucent white glass, fine white borders and boxShadow:'0 20px 60px rgba(0,102,255,0.25)'. Keep card geometry front-facing. · DATABASE hero: one clean SVG, exactly eight elements—outer body, top ellipse, bottom arc, two layer arcs and three short record rules. Use electric-blue gradients and rounded stroke caps; no extra decorative illustration. · Carry the existing rounded blue record token and its compact ID forward unchanged, including its short horizontal notch. Seat it beside the cylinder in a CSS slot; never duplicate it or use it as voter identification. · Compact record-inspection well using background:'rgba(15,23,42,0.85)', backdropFilter:'blur(14px)', border:'1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10)' and borderRadius:24px. Its emerald check is explicitly labeled 'RECORD CHECK ONLY'. · Attached amber 'MIGHT' tag visible throughout. Right-card condition fields are equal-height rounded panels with neutral empty evidence slots; no scores, crosses or success marks. · Coral <mg.FocusFrame> surrounding the election conditions and the status 'NOT ESTABLISHED BY THE DATABASE'. Rounded connector below the cards ends flat at the scope gap under 'DOES NOT ESTABLISH ELECTION QUALITY'; no arrow toward the election.
WORD SYNC  W587 → F2: the inherited record token and left glass card begin their restrained spring entrance. Amber MIGHT is already legible; the first recognizable database form is visible by f21.
           W590 → F47–78: finish seating the blue token in its record slot and complete the eight-element database assembly. No identity or election-quality indicator activates.
           W591 → F103–125: give the persistent MIGHT tag one subtle amber emphasis, completing by f125; leave it visible through the end.
           W596 → F190–226: a single restrained blue highlight sweep resolves the cylinder's surface and three record rules. Begin the gentle database-focused camera easing.
           W597 → F223–258: scan only the record slot, then resolve the emerald check and 'RECORD CHECK ONLY'. Finish the database-focused camera move by f258.
           W598 → F304–323: track across the scope gap and unfold the equal-size ELECTION card. Its heading, all three inherited condition labels and empty evidence slots are readable by f323.
           W600 → F341–361: progressively reveal the broad lower connector from the record check toward the scope gap. One blue packet reaches its flat endpoint and stops. Fully reveal 'DOES NOT ESTABLISH ELECTION QUALITY' by f361.
           W602 → F402–424: finish the restrained push toward the election conditions without changing the equal card sizes or filling any evidence slot.
           W603 → F448–492: settle the rounded coral <mg.FocusFrame> around the three condition fields and reveal 'NOT ESTABLISHED BY THE DATABASE'. Complete by f492; do not substitute a failure verdict.
           W604 → By f546: complete the wide pullback at zoom1.0, x0/y0. Retain both equal cards, MIGHT, the record-only check, the terminated connector and the unchanged blue token; hold quietly through f566.
AVOID  Treating record verification as identity verification, ballot secrecy, freedom from coercion or overall election quality. · Implying that the database causes election risks; never bridge the scope gap with a causal arrow. · Failure crosses, filled election evidence slots, invented scores, statistics or universal blockchain-security claims. · Removing MIGHT, altering the spoken line, changing the recurring token ID or duplicating the token. · Sharp-cornered rectangles, decorative circuitry, extra icons, random flicker, looping bounces, camera roll or excessive perspective. · Clipped critical labels, moving the headline with the camera, zoom above1.3 or dissolving the final comparison before the narration ends.
